svg.text: One trade through the model — LDM 1.22 with real data in the boxes
Calypso IRS 987654321 (USD 100M, 4.25% vs SOFR, Sep-2026 → Sep-2031, cpty JPM) · the same trade from the TMS slide · mesh zones tagged in purple
Product PRD-77102 — the legs live here
instrument: none — legIds 1 & 2 are what metric rows cite
Position Metric — many rows decorate position 3000987-001 (join keys on every row)
legId blank = trade-level row · populated = that Product leg · Cashflow row also carries dates: period 2026-09-11→2027-03-11, pay 2027-03-13
fxConversionFlag = N on all rows (native USD) · leg NPVs sum to the trade NPV: −98,120,400 + 98,658,600 = +538,200
still missing (the open ask): Run Identifier — nothing here says these 3 deltas are the complete official-EOD set
Mesh 5 Silver (metric rows) — written via 7a zero-copy by W2 Risk workspace
RCAPS (risk engine) → NPVs + deltas: calc system ≠ position system
CALYPSO (book of record) → realized cash + projected cashflows
the BOR resolves the position · engines only decorate it
Record Metadata — birth certificate of one row
The same picture, folded onto your mesh diagram:
5 Silver: Position + Product + Metric rows, CDM-conformed
W2 Risk workspace consumes positions, produces metric rows
CDM = the contract each hop conforms to — data lives in domain workspaces; the LDM itself never holds data. This page is the physical story of one trade obeying that contract.
